changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: Duplicate customer owner emails exist. Resolve them before applying customer email uniqueness; no customer data has been removed.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT lower(trim(owner_email)) FROM arena.customer WHERE owner_email IS NOT NULL AND trim(owner_email) != '' GROUP BY lower(trim(owner_email)) HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicates

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customer_owner_email_normalized ON arena.customer (lower(trim(owner_email))) WHERE owner_email IS NOT NULL AND trim(owner_email) != '';
